entries.title: Psalms 71:1
segments: ¶In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed.

entries.title: Psalms 71:2
segments: Keep me safe in your righteousness, and come to my help; give ear to my voice, and be my saviour.

entries.title: Psalms 71:3
segments: Be my strong Rock, the strong place of my salvation; for you are my Rock, and my safe place.

entries.title: Psalms 71:4
segments: O my God, take me out of the hand of the sinner, out of the hand of the evil and cruel man.

entries.title: Psalms 71:5
segments: For you are my hope, O Lord God; I have had faith in you from the time when I was young.

entries.title: Psalms 71:6
segments: You have been my support from the day of my birth; you took me out of my mother's body; my praise will be ever of you.

entries.title: Psalms 71:7
segments: I am a wonder to all; but you are my strong tower.

entries.title: Psalms 71:8
segments: My mouth will be full of your praise and glory all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 71:9
segments: Do not give me up when I am old; be my help even when my strength is gone.

entries.title: Psalms 71:10
segments: For my haters are waiting secretly for me; and those who are watching for my soul are banded together in their evil designs,

entries.title: Psalms 71:11
segments: Saying, God has given him up; go after him and take him, for he has no helper.

entries.title: Psalms 71:12
segments: O God, be not far from me; O my God, come quickly to my help.

entries.title: Psalms 71:13
segments: Let those who say evil against my soul be overcome and put to shame; let my haters be made low and have no honour.

entries.title: Psalms 71:14
segments: ¶But I will go on ever hoping, and increasing in all your praise.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
segments: My mouth will make clear your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for they are more than may be measured.

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
segments: I will give news of the great acts of the Lord God; my words will be of your righteousness, and of yours only.

entries.title: Psalms 71:17
segments: O God, you have been my teacher from the time when I was young; and I have been talking of your works of wonder even till now.

entries.title: Psalms 71:18
segments: Now when I am old and grey-headed, O God, give me not up; till I have made clear your strength to this generation, and your power to all those to come.

entries.title: Psalms 71:19
segments: Your righteousness, O God, is very high; you have done great things; O God, who is like you?

entries.title: Psalms 71:20
segments: You, who have sent great and bitter troubles on me, will give me life again, lifting me up from the deep waters of the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 71:21
segments: You will make me greater than before, and give me comfort on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 71:22
segments: I will give praise to you with instruments of music, O my God, for you are true; I will make songs to you with music, O Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 71:23
segments: Joy will be on my lips when I make melody to you; and in my soul, to which you have given salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 71:24
segments: My tongue will be talking of your righteousness all the day; for those whose purpose is to do me evil have been crushed and put to shame.
